ci.description: Full CI pipeline (all checks in parallel where possible)

install.command: mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && cargo build --release && cp target/release/oya ~/.local/bin/oya && chmod +x ~/.local/bin/oya && echo '✅ Installed oya to ~/.local/bin/oya'

install-zellij.description: Install Zellij plugin to user config
install-zellij.command: mkdir -p ~/.config/zellij/plugins && cp target/wasm32-wasip1/release/zellij_frontend.wasm ~/.config/zellij/plugins/ && cp crates/zellij-frontend/plugin.yaml ~/.config/zellij/plugins/oya.yaml && echo '✅ Installed zellij-frontend plugin to ~/.config/zellij/plugins/'

mutants.description: Run mutation testing on all 2000+ mutations

mutants-diff.description: Mutation test only files changed vs main branch

mutants-package.description: Run mutation testing on specific package (use -p PKG)

mutants-quick.description: Quick mutation test on core packages
mutants-quick.command: cargo mutants -p oya-core -p oya-workflow -p oya-events --baseline run

quick.description: Fast lint check (format + clippy in parallel)

serve.description: Run full stack server (frontend + API on http://localhost:3000)
